newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia plans to issue "energy bonds" - Nemtsov.
newsitem.headline: Russia plans to issue "energy bonds" - Nemtsov.

text.p: The Russian government plans to issue about three trillion roubles of "energy bonds" this year to raise funds to prepare for the winter, Energy Minister Boris Nemtsov said on Thursday.

Nemtsov, who is also a First Deputy Prime Minister charged with restructuring the energy sector and monopolies, told a cabinet meeting the government was urging regional governments to make similar bond issues.
He gave no details of the planned issue.
Many Russian power companies are heavily indebted to their suppliers, who in turn owe large back taxes to the government.
The government is putting pressure on energy suppliers to pay their taxes, raising the possibility that they will cut off supplies to the power companies to force them to pay their bills.
